Every article here answers one question in its first paragraph and then earns it. Structured that way on purpose — so an answer engine can quote the answer, and so you can leave after the first paragraph if that is all you needed.

Creative Strategy · 6 min

Should you rebrand before rebuilding your website?

Yes, in almost every case. A website is an application of a brand system; building one before the system exists means building it twice.

Full article publishing in phase 1

Brand Development · 8 min

What is actually in a brand system?

Rules, not files. Colour roles, a type scale, spacing, motion, photography direction and voice — enough that someone who has never met you can produce on-brand work.

Full article publishing in phase 1

Website Design · 5 min

What is a good conversion rate for a B2B services website?

Between 2% and 5% of visitors to enquiry is typical. The more useful number is the one you are at now, which most businesses cannot state.

Full article publishing in phase 1

Marketing Automation · 4 min

How fast do you need to respond to a new lead?

Inside five minutes to be competitive, inside sixty seconds to be memorable. After an hour you are usually competing for a decision that has already been made.

Full article publishing in phase 1

Ongoing Marketing · 6 min

When should you start running paid ads?

After the position is settled and the landing page converts. Paid amplifies whatever is underneath it, including the problems.

Full article publishing in phase 1

Creative Strategy · 7 min

Should you hire an agency or build the function in-house?

In-house wins on context and consistency. Agencies win on range and speed of setup. The honest split is usually agency to build the system, in-house to run it.

Full article publishing in phase 1

Why the answer comes first

Search is increasingly answered rather than listed. An article that buries its conclusion under six hundred words of preamble does not get quoted, and a page nobody quotes does not get found. The structure is the SEO.
